# The Pooja Edit — by Pooja Dugar

> Realistic, wearable Indian fashion from a solo Instagram-led brand
> (@poojadugar_). Two catalogs: The Label (Pooja's own designs) and The
> Closet (one-of-one pre-loved pieces from her own wardrobe). Ships across
> India.

## Catalogs

- The Label (`/label`): Pooja's own designs — kurtis, co-ord sets and linen,
  made in real sizes and small runs.
- The Closet (`/closet`): Pooja's own wardrobe, passed on. Every piece is
  one-of-one; once it's sold, it's gone. Sold as-is, final sale.

## Ordering

- Payment: online only (UPI / card / netbanking) via Razorpay. Cash on
  delivery is not offered.
- Shipping: ships across India via Shadowfax. The Label ships in about
  5-10 business days (made to order/slow-made); The Closet dispatches within
  about 2 working days.
- Returns: differ by catalog — see `/policies/returns-exchanges` for current
  terms (this page is still being finalized by the owner; treat it as
  provisional, not final, as of this file's last update).
